roles.title: UI/UX Designer
bullets: Designed the user experience for Cyclefy, a web platform promoting the circular economy among students, covering donation, bartering, borrowing, recycling and repair services.
Ran usability testing and iterated on the designs based on user feedback.
Worked with front-end developers on design hand-off.
roles.honor: Awarded Best Project of the ASE Lab Internship Program for Cyclefy.

roles.title: Web Developer
bullets: Worked in a team of seven on Digi Money Manager, a web-based project finance system for reimbursements and project financial records, using Rapid Application Development (RAD).
Designed all screens in Figma on my own, for the five user roles.
Built front-end modules and supporting endpoints together with other team members.
Fixed QA findings in my modules and wrote the user manual with the team.

roles.title: Head of Information and Communication Division
bullets: Managed the organization's social media accounts, including content planning, scheduling and publishing.
Designed social media content such as feed posts, stories and event posters to promote events and programs.
Supervised the media team and coordinated collaboration across divisions.
